latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the brand-protection-ebay skill.

- Detect unauthorized sellers and counterfeits on eBay.
- Monitor prices for MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) violations.
- Identify potential trademark abuse in listing titles and descriptions.
- Generate VeRO complaint templates and enforcement guides.
- No API key required for use.
- Includes step-by-step action workflow and risk level categorization.
